name: Prismveil Tailored Chromeskin Showcase Suit
description: A Tier 4 club suit designed explicitly to make augmentation the centerpiece of the look — a structured single-button jacket in deep obsidian holographic-trim silk-synthetic, the lapels edged with a hair-thin line of color-shifting iridescent foil that shifts from violet to copper to silver depending on viewing angle and ambient light. The jacket is cut long in the back, short in the front, with both sleeves removed entirely and replaced by open chrome display channels — structured fabric cuffs at the shoulder that frame chrome arms the way a gallery frames sculpture, the metal polished to mirror finish and highlighted by the jacket's color-shift trim reflecting across it. Underneath, a fitted high-neck underlayer in sheer black mesh with bioluminescent thread woven through in geometric patterns that pulse slowly — breath-rate synchronized via BCI — casting faint light upward onto the jaw. Trousers are slim-cut in the same obsidian holographic fabric, with a discreet horn accommodation loop at the waistband for smaller geneware and a structured exterior tail sheath of matching material for those with longer geneware. Shoes are pointed chelsea boots in liquid-chrome finish, mirror-polished.
functionality: BCI-synchronized bioluminescent thread requires active neural port connection to animate — disconnected, it glows at a static dim baseline. Chrome display channels are precision-fitted to standard aug arm shoulder joints but include micro-adjustment tabs for custom chrome widths. Tail sheath has internal reinforcement to hold shape independently. Horn loop is adjustable via concealed internal drawstring.
what_it_says: This is someone who paid to be looked at and knows exactly what they're doing. The chrome isn't hidden or apologized for — it's lit and framed and presented. The BCI-synced breathing pulse in the mesh says their body and their tech are integrated at a level that costs real QUANTA. Tier 4 confidence: not quite Spire untouchable, but absolutely above asking permission.
worn_by: junior corporate executives on personal time
chrome-augmented professionals with aesthetic investment in their modifications
manufacturer: Vanthorpe Atelier — Tier 4 bespoke label, corponation-adjacent but independently operated
story_hooks: The BCI synchronization pulse is being read by a surveillance system in the club — someone is building a biometric profile on every person wearing BCI-linked clothing tonight.
The mirror-polish chrome arms catch a reflection that shouldn't exist — a face in the crowd that security cameras show isn't there.

A Tier 5 power broker sends a drink to the wearer's table with a note: 'I funded the aug. I want to discuss the terms of that investment.' The chrome wasn't bought — it was installed as part of a deal the wearer may not have fully read.
